sloka: ततः शूर्पणखा दीना रावणम् लोक रावणम् ।अमात्य मध्ये संक्रुद्धा परुषम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-३३-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā dīnā rāvaṇam loka rāvaṇam ।amātya madhye saṁkruddhā paruṣam vākyam abravīt ॥3-33-1॥

translations.english: When the distressed, anguished Surpanakha met Ravana who makes the world weep, he was seated in the midst of his ministers. She addressed him these harsh words:
